question: Which mantra syllable should be placed in the middle of the left eye next?
premises: The locus is the middle of the left eye.
The syllable to be placed is omuṃ.
inference: The practitioner should next place the omuṃ syllable in the middle of the left eye.
plain_english: Next, one should place the omuṃ syllable in the middle of the left eye.
